recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended unless FHIR-I separately decides to make another editorial wording change to the exchange module.
issue_request: FHIR-15132 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 non-substantive FHIR-I change request for the foundation module section 2.0.2.2. It asked to improve the messaging sentence from "supports exchange between systems by exchanging content by sending routed messages" to cleaner wording about content exchange between systems by sending routed messages, with resolution "Change as indicated."
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 13396, represented in Git as 5dd2aa9f48ad5d0df6b4e6d5e72d4879e85d34ef. That commit changed source/foundation-module.html by removing the redundant "by exchanging content" phrase. Commit c397bd0b1f4c760dd227af300eaa8044b9e968a3 then moved the exchange-method material from foundation-module.html into source/exchange-module.html.
additional_context: Current source/hierarchy.xml lists exchange-module.html as an active module page, and source/exchange-module.html retains the cleaned messaging sentence. Source, Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no stale old phrase, no related Jira beyond FHIR-15132 for the phrase, and no conflicting community context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already removes the duplicated wording and preserves the intended meaning; changing it now to the literal Jira suggestion would be optional editorial churn rather than a necessary current-spec correction.
